How Gut Fibre™ works

PHGG (partially hydrolysed guar gum) is fuel for your good gut bugs, helps form softer & easier-to-pass poops, supports smoother digestion and a less dramatic gut environment.


PHGG is the best form of fibre for your gut as it's low FODMAP friendly. It doesn't make you more constipated like other fibres (psyllium).

Ingredients (Unflavoured)

All-natural, no nasty, clean ingredients.

Gut Fibre™: 100% Sunfiber® Partially Hydrolysed Guar Gum.

How to use

Mix 1 scoop (7g) into your smoothie, coffee, yoghurt, water, whatever fits your routine. It's tasteless, easy to dissolve & made for daily use.

FAQs

Will this make me more bloated?

No! PuraU Gut Fibre is made with 100% Sunfiber® PHGG, a gentle, low-fermenting prebiotic fibre. Unlike traditional fibres like Psyllium that can feel heavy or cause gas when introduced too quickly, PHGG ferments slowly and is clinically shown to be well tolerated, even for sensitive tummies.

Does it taste chalky?

No. It’s completely tasteless and grit-free. Gut Fibre dissolves clear in water, coffee, smoothies or juice without thickening or changing the flavour, so you won’t even know it’s there.

How quickly will I notice a difference?

Many people notice improvements in stool consistency and regularity within a few days. For optimal digestive balance and microbiome support, we recommend taking it daily for at least 2–4 weeks. Consistency is key.

Will it make me run to the toilet?

No, this isn’t a laxative. PHGG works gently by supporting stool consistency and feeding beneficial gut bacteria, helping to promote regular, comfortable bowel movements without urgency.

Can I take this every day?

Yes. Gut Fibre is designed for daily use. Each serve provides 6.1g of fibre (up to 24% of your daily needs), making it an easy way to support smoother digestion and long-term gut health as part of your routine.
